intro.name: L.E.Santhosh Kumar
intro.role: IAM Integration Specialist · Full Stack Engineer
intro.subHeading: I architect identity & access management solutions and build scalable web applications with Java, React, SQL, NoSQL, and Elasticsearch.

about: With over 12 years of experience, I specialize as an **IAM Integration Specialist**, architecting enterprise-grade identity and access management solutions. I design secure, standards-compliant authentication and authorization flows using **Keycloak**, **Okta**, **OAuth 2.0**, **OpenID Connect (OIDC)**, and **SAML 2.0** — building multi-tenant SSO platforms, enforcing MFA, and implementing role-based and attribute-based access control across complex distributed systems.

As a full-stack engineer, I build scalable backend services with **Java** and **Spring Boot** and dynamic frontends with **React**. I have deep hands-on experience across relational and non-relational databases — **PostgreSQL**, **MSSQL** (including column-level Always On encryption), **MongoDB**, and **Elasticsearch** — enabling high-performance data access, search, and analytics at scale.

**Notable achievements include:**
- Architected a web-based **AS400/IBMi emulator** (TN5250), modernizing legacy systems with ReactJS and Spring Boot, bridging mainframe infrastructure with modern web frontends.
- Integrated multiple **third-party APIs** — including Clickatell SMS gateway, Highcharts analytics, and enterprise ERP connectors — streamlining cross-platform data flows.
- Implemented **MSSQL Always On column-level encryption** and **OKTA SSO**, strengthening enterprise security posture and ensuring compliance.
Beyond full-stack engineering, I'm a passionate solo game developer, currently exploring Unreal Engine and Blender to build immersive 2D/3D game worlds, inspired by my favorite RPGs.

experience.description:
- Architected and implemented **IAM integrations** using **Keycloak**, enabling SSO, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC flows, and role-based access control across microservices.
- Successfully modernized an enterprise web application, migrating its legacy **Acegi Security** framework to a modern **Spring Security** architecture
- Built a web-based **AS400/IBMi TN5250 emulator** using ReactJS and Spring Boot, modernizing legacy mainframe interfaces for enterprise users.
- Integrated third-party APIs and enterprise connectors, improving cross-system data exchange and reducing manual integration effort by 30%.
- Mentored junior developers on IAM standards, secure coding practices, and microservices architecture best practices.

- Implemented **OKTA authentication** and **MSSQL Always On column-level encryption**, strengthening enterprise security and compliance posture.
- Integrated the **Clickatell** SMS gateway API and other third-party services, streamlining real-time user communication workflows.
- Built a scalable Sports ERP API backed by **PostgreSQL** and **MongoDB**, improving data integration and cross-platform access.
- Engineered **Elasticsearch**-powered search and analytics, increasing data retrieval speed and accuracy by 40%.
- Led development of a sports game simulation module, reducing QA testing time by 70% and accelerating release cycles.

- Owned and maintained a **JavaFX**-based desktop application, ensuring stability, performance, and smooth user experience.
- Integrated the **Highcharts** third-party charting API for visual data insights, improving analytics usability and clarity.
- Built a custom CMS, improving content delivery speed by 30% and enhancing overall system efficiency.

- Designing and prototyping 2D and 3D gameplay mechanics using Unreal Engine 5, with a focus on action RPG and exploration-based genres.
- Developing skills in Blueprint visual scripting and transitioning into C++ to build reusable gameplay systems like inventory, combat, and quest management.
- Creating and animating 3D models, environments, and characters using Blender, including asset sculpting, UV mapping, rigging, and basic animation cycles.
